project.name: Library Desk
project.description: A web app where members borrow books and staff manage the catalogue.

requirements.title: Borrow a book
requirements.description: A signed-in member borrows an available book for 14 days.
acceptance_criteria: An available book can be borrowed and shows a due date 14 days away
A member cannot borrow more than 5 books at once
A book that is already on loan cannot be borrowed

requirements.title: Member sign in
requirements.description: Members sign in with a library card number and a PIN.
acceptance_criteria: Valid card number and PIN open the member home page
A wrong PIN shows an error and does not reveal whether the card exists
Three wrong PINs in a row lock the card for 15 minutes

requirements.title: GET /books/{id} returns a book
requirements.description: Returns the title, author and availability of one book. GET /books/{id}
acceptance_criteria: An existing id returns 200 with title, author and availability

requirements.title: Member data access
requirements.description: Members can only see their own loans.
acceptance_criteria: A member cannot open another member loan history
Sessions end after 20 minutes of inactivity

requirements.title: Catalogue search speed
requirements.description: Catalogue search must stay fast under load: p95 under 600 ms at 100 concurrent users.
acceptance_criteria: Catalogue search p95 latency is under 600 ms at 100 concurrent users
